events.name: In The Eyes of

options.text: No, my decision is made!
Very well, we shall remain wed.

events.text: The cries of anger from the gathered mob can be heard even from your private chambers. [character] wasted no time upon hearing of your intentions for a divorce, swiftly securing the support of [character], the Head of [religion]. He is determined to remain [title], and so together they roused the faithful of the city to protest against the divorce. Now the duo sit in your chambers, awaiting your answer. [character] reminds you of his power to denounce your name to the faithful. Will you continue with the divorce or is the risk of upsetting the [religion] too great?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: In Your Honor

options.text: A formal exhibition of [rival] arts and culture.
A binge of wine, song, and social merrymaking.
No celebration is required. The gift speaks for itself.

events.text: Chancellor [character] returns from the [family] estate with good news. The [family] are so pleased with our gifts that they wish to host a celebration in your honor in [city]. No expense will be spared. What type of festivities would you prefer?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: In the Balance

options.text: Remove the Governor. He will be replaced.
Refuse their demands.
Establish a new guard to restore order.

events.text: When the citizens of [city] learn that we have sent agents to quell the unrest, mobs descend on the governor's palace. Forcing their way inside, they take Governor [character] and his court hostage. What shall we do? [character]'s life hangs in the balance. The people demand new leadership.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: In the Field

options.text: Sadly, I do not have the time, but good luck.
Of course, I will join you in the wilds of [rival].

events.text: When you arrive in [city] to inspire the troops, an opportunity arises. Several units of infantryman are about to embark on a wilderness expedition meant to test their survival strength, resourcefulness, and stealth. The officers in charge extend an invitation. If you have the time, they would love for you to join them in this bonding exercise and pass on your wisdom to the young recruits.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Influence Inflicted

options.text: Fighting is the only language he will understand.
Guards, seize this man for attacking me!
If it’s a fight he wants…

events.text: [character] charges into the hall, fully armed and ready for battle. “WHERE IS HE?” he roars, brandishing his weapons at the stunned surrounding servants. Eyes finally alighting on you, [character] surges forwards. “Enough with all these words and messages to try and influence me. Meet me in combat and we will finally reach an understanding.”

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Influence in Court

options.text: Ruin the [rival] Heir's reputation.
Slow and complicate the governing process.

events.text: Somehow, resourceful [character] has positioned himself as a servant in the court of [city], where he is able to overhear the city's leaders. After several weeks, he begins to carefully exert influence over the weakest courtiers, pushing them towards policies hurtful to [rival] and helpful to [rival].

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Influence of Council

options.text: We can accommodate this request.
It is not in our best interest to remove [character]
Let us talk about other possibilities.

events.text: [character] marches into the court, servants in tow, before coming to a sudden stop and bowing low before you. His voice rings out, "Your majesty seeks my support. I will aid you upon one condition. Remove [character] and give me his position as Ambassador" What shall we do about this delicate matter?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Influence of Council

options.text: We can accommodate this request.
It is not in our best interest to remove [character]
Let us talk about other possibilities.

events.text: [character] marches into the court, a single servant in tow, before coming to a sudden stop and bowing low before you. He speaks in a diplomatic tone, "Your majesty seeks my support. I will aid you upon one condition. Remove [character] and give me his position as Chancellor." How shall we resolve this delicate issue?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Influence of Council

options.text: We can accommodate this request.
It is not in our best interest to remove [character]
Let us talk about other possibilities.

events.text: [character] marches into the court, a single servant in tow, before coming to a sudden stop and bowing low before you. He speaks in a furtive whisper, "Your majesty seeks my support. I will aid you upon one condition. Remove [character] and give me his position as Spymaster." How shall we resolve this delicate issue?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Influence of God's Consort

options.text: [character] is proving worthy of the title!

events.text: When [character] is brought before you, he is already receptive to your influence. He says that [character] approached him for support, and how can one refuse Gods Consort?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Influence of Governors

options.text: We can accommodate this request.
Regretfully, we cannot accept this request.
Ha! Never talk business when I'm drinking! Come join me!

events.text: During an evening meal with your courtiers, [character] takes you outside into the crisp night air, away from the music and revelry. "I received your messages and..." [character] drums his thumb on the gold chalice in his hand. "I will support you on one condition - the Governorship of [city]." This will upset the current Governor, [character]. How shall we respond?

events.author: Zorbaz
conditions: Not Any Descendant Of Leader Us
events.name: Influence of Money

options.text: We can come to an arrangement.
Sadly, [character], you ask too much.
I will not be tainted by your foul schemes!

events.text: [character] asks to speak with you privately, gesturing to a secluded hallway. Servants and courtiers carry on about their business in the wide halls. "Your majesty has taken an interest in me," [character] says and smiles with practiced ease. "But I do not wish to flatter myself. Instead, I would like to propose a deal where I gain your financial support in return for my political support."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Influence of Religion

options.text: Inspire him with your fervor.

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: Inspire him with your piety.
Pressure him into accepting [religion].

events.text: An interesting opportunity has arisen in your attempts to influence [character]. One of your advisors has pointed out that [character] does not currently follow your State Religion of [religion]. Convincing [character] to follow would give you political and religious sway over him.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Influence of Terror

options.text: Yes, [character] must fear me.
No, this is not the way.
This conversation is yet salvageable!

events.text: You corner [character] in a hallway of the palace late at night. He has proven a tough man to track down. Beads of sweat dot his face as you pressure him into a personal alliance. Your attempt at persuasion is going badly. Perhaps you should take a different tack, and rely on your terrifying presence to bend [character] to your will?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Influence of Weakness

options.text: Take hold of yourself!
Just a little while longer...
Abandon this pursuit.

events.text: Your attempts to influence [character] are close to bearing fruit. However, spending so much time with the [trait] man is starting to take effect. You notice yourself acting in similar ways to your target, agreeing more and more with his way of thinking.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Influence of Wine

options.text: Yes, I accept your offer.
No, I will not defile my marriage.
Guards! Throw [character] in jail!
It is not your body I want, but your blood.

events.text: Returning to your bedchambers, you are surprised to find [character] there. As he walks towards you, you notice that his face is flushed, and a nearly empty pitcher of wine sits on the table. "Come, join me." [character] takes your hand, looks deeply into your eyes, and moves to kiss you. "I know you want me as an ally. This is the price." How shall you respond to these advances?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Influence of the Religion Head

options.text: Introduce him to [character].
Encourage his faith through other priests.
This is not worth it.

events.text: [character] replies to your messages of interest with a sudden and surprising fervor. It appears that he has been growing curious about the ways of your State Religion, [religion]. Introducing him to [character] could influence [character], but would also give [character] increased sway at your court. Shall we make the introductions?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Influential Ideas

options.text: Mistake or not, a punishment is necessary.
Brand [character] a traitor to [rival].
Offer forgiveness for the mistake.

events.text: Reports indicate that someone in your court has been sharing information with the [rival], and [character] has been heard boasting of how he is eager to put the [rival] technology to use. Following the trail, your agents discover that the breakthrough came from a message from [character] to a distant relative in the foreign nation. Your guards intercept a subsequent message in which [character] is asking the relative to hide any involvement, confirming the suspicions. Brought before you in tears, [character] professes innocence, claiming that the first message was a thoughtless mistake.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Bond

options.text: Allow [character] to visit whenever possible.
Allow it this once.
Do not compare my child to [character]’s.

events.text: While interceding on your behalf, [character] discovered that [character] has a child a similar age to [character]. He suggests that encouraging a companionship between the two children could be an easy way to sway [character]. An invitation for the child, [character], to spend time at the palace would help your cause, but could be seen as beneath your station.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Compulsion

options.text: [character] went too far.
Praise him for getting the desired results.
Smooth things over with the clergy.

events.text: [character] has returned to you with news of his intercession. Although successful, [character] is worried that he went too far to get the desired results, threatening [character] with the wrath of. The priests who were present have been spreading discontent amongst the [religion], worried about your influence on [character].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Confusion

options.text: You are wasting my time.
Thank him for trying.
Do it properly this time, or else.

events.text: [character] comes to you in triumph. “Never fear, I have done as you asked and interceded with [character] on your behalf!” …[character]? [character] stops short, your questioning look briefly breaking through his. He sheepishly asks, “Oh no. It was supposed to be [character] wasn’t it?”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Conversion

requirements.label: Diplomat / Judge / High Charisma
tip: The leader must have one of: Diplomat; Judge; High Charisma

options.text: Mediate between the two of them.
Force [character] to apologize.
The damage is already done.

events.text: [character]’s attempts to sway [character] for you have gone wrong. Very, very wrong. After a shouting match that was heard across the city, rumors are quickly spreading about how [character] has threatened to deny all [religion] rites and worship to [character]. [character] has retorted that he intends to convert to [religion] instead. It may be your turn to intercede before things get out of hand.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Debate

options.text: There’s always another way, pressure [character] instead.
[religion] can’t afford to lose face, buy [character]’s silence about this meeting.
He’s right, you’ve shown yourself as a fool.

events.text: [character] met with [character] as planned, with the aim of swaying him to your cause. However, things took a sideways turn when they began talking about [religion] as the inquisitive [character] <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_SCHOLAR>started questioning the sources and evidence behind [character]’s arguments<p=SUBJECT_EDUCATED>quoted a series of lessons from his education that [character] had clearly never heard of<else>asked thoughtful questions about the nature of the divine that [character] had no answer for<end>. [character] was left at a loss for words and was entirely unable to convince [character] of anything, let alone of your greatness. He returns to you in embarrassment.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Deception

options.text: Remind [character] of my terrible power.
Remind [character] of my generous love.
They are not worth my time.

events.text: Your Spymaster [character] brings word that [character]’s efforts to intercede with [character] for you have been met with resistance. Although [character] has been acting receptive and jovial, in secret he is undermining [character] and uniting the [family] family against the two of you using charisma and coercion. [character] asks what message you would like to send to bring [character] and the [family] back in line.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Donation

options.text: Humbly decline the offer.
Ask for him to fund a disciple.
We need money to aid. Lots of money.

events.text: A message arrives from [character]: “After the many kind words that [character] has spoken of you, I am convinced that you are a just follower of [religion]. Please allow me to send a gift to add to glory in [rival].” A generous offer, what will you ask for?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Duel

options.text: Family fighting family is a crime worthy of death.
Banish [character] from our lands.
[character] is free to go.

events.text: Your servants bring news of a brutal fight within the [family] family that has disgusted the capital. [character] was speaking to [character] on your behalf when [character] began mocking and criticizing you. When [character] defended your good character, [character] demanded that they duel. In the fight [character]’s <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_CORRUPT>corrupt<p=SUBJECT_PROUD>proud<p=SUBJECT_BLOODTHIRSTY>bloodthirsty<p=SUBJECT_RUTHLESS>ruthless<p=SUBJECT_GREEDY>greedy<else>cruel<end> nature was revealed as he <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_CORRUPT>bribed the guards to beat [character] to death before they could even fight<p=SUBJECT_PROUD>refused to back down from his words, even if it meant killing [character]<p=SUBJECT_BLOODTHIRSTY>gave [character] no respite, gleefully hacking into him and reveling in the slaughter<p=SUBJECT_RUTHLESS>struck [character] down even when he was asking for mercy<p=SUBJECT_GREEDY>aimed to kill [character] in hopes of gaining some of the family’s fortune<else>severely wounded [character]<end>. The other families are shocked at such violence within a noble house, but it could be a good chance to sway [character] if that is still your plan. He is brought before you in chains, what will you decree?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Elopement

options.text: They will be met with guards, accusing [character] of kidnapping [character].
Meet them with open arms. [character] is a surprising addition to the family, but a welcome one.

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: [character] is free to leave but they will not marry. I have not been keeping a watchful enough eye on [character].

events.text: [character] rushes to you with potentially disastrous news. In his attempts to sway [character] for you, [character] encouraged [character] to meet with your son, [character]. What started as a diplomatic meeting evolved into something more, and the two have been secretly meeting ever since. [character]’s agents have discovered that the young lovers are planning on eloping that very night, and he gives you the details of the meeting place. You make haste to reach it before them - what reception will they find there?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Exile

options.text: Get him back. Now.
You did what was right.

events.text: To say that the meeting between [character] and [character] did not go well would be an understatement. Their explosive relationship came to a head with [character] using his power as the head of the [family] to tell [character] to leave and never return. [character] stands before you, well aware that he failed in what you asked, but stubbornly blaming [character]’s character for their disagreements.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Feast

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: Have him disciplined for his words.
Let it pass.
Graciously accept the apology.

events.text: The wine is flowing freely and everyone is in high spirits. [character] has been interceding with [character] on your behalf and this final step in his plan seems to be working; you spend much of the evening with [character], drinking and laughing together. Or at least you are until, red-cheeked and slurring, [character] carelessly makes a series of slanderous remarks about you and your family. The laughter quickly dies from his eyes as he realizes what he just said, and to who. [character] is quick to apologize. Was the outburst an effect of the drink or revealing of his true feelings?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Greed

options.text: Agree, his services were worth it.
Refuse, he has already been paid enough.
Demand back what he was paid before.

events.text: [character]’s greed knows no bounds. The intercession went without a problem and [character] has been swayed to appreciate you more. But now [character] has started sending messages asking for more payment for his service. Will you indulge this avarice?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Loyalty

options.text: A tale of the wisdom of the tricksters.
An epic of heroes and their cunning.
This collection would better aid the court.

events.text: Since the intercession, [character] has been almost unquestioningly loyal to you. When pressed, [character] admits that he told [character] that you are a great fan of the epics, knowing that it was a good way to win him over. [character] reveals that he has been building a collection of rare stories and scrolls and offers you a gift of one of them. What will you ask for?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Parricide

options.text: Very well, you have a deal.
Don’t try and use me for your games.
Imprison [character] for his plot against [character].

events.text: In a surprise visit, [character] comes to you directly. “I know you sent [character] to win me over but it won’t work. If you want my support then there is something that I want in return. The [family] are suffering under the leadership of [character]. Were an accident to befall him… I hope that you know that I would be a loyal subject of yours with my increased influence within the [family] family.” [character] stands at the ready. Will you aid this scheming family member?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Replacement

options.text: Offer [character] support in his plan.
Send a warning to [character].
[character] is too dangerous, have [character] ‘remove’ the problem.

events.text: Your Spymaster [character] took the precaution of setting an agent to track the progress of [character]’s intercession. What was discovered is a much greater plot with implications for the entire world. [character] has been using all of his support and contacts to maneuver to be able to take the position as Religion Head of [religion]. It seems that [character] has no idea and is due to meet with [character] the following week, in what is most likely a trap. This surprising information has put you in a position of power. What will you do with what you know?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Rivals

options.text: This can be saved with a bit of charm.
You are obviously not trying hard enough.
Very well, a rivalry it is.

events.text: For every praise that [character] has heaped upon you to [character], [character] has found a way to interpret it as a flaw. Every strength is called a weakness and every action is belittled and dismissed. [character] returns to you at a loss. It seems that [character] is determined to build a rivalry between the two of you. How will you react?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Romance

options.text: Admit that you feel the same.
Refuse, he is out of line.

events.text: [character] meets you in your private chambers and informs you that his attempts to intercede with [character] have been a success. He moves to leave, but hesitates by the door. Turning back to you [character] starts speaking softly but urgently, confessing that while spending time convincing [character] of your qualities, he has come to realize that he loves you. [character] draws close and tentatively places a hand over yours. Will you accept this declaration of love?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Sacrifice

options.text: Impress [character] with your piety.
Have your scribes write him a treatise on [religion].
Pay for dedications to in his name.
[character]’s word should be enough.

events.text: [character] has sent word that he has managed to persuade [character] of the quality of your character through extolling your piety. True or not, a gift of writing or prayers would convince [character] of your dedication to and fully endear him to you. Are you willing to go the extra distance to impress [character]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Suspicion

options.text: Take no chances. If he makes a sudden move, kill him.
Meet alone as a show of trust.
Meet, but take your guards.

events.text: Your Spymaster [character] urgently asks to speak with you. He quickly relays that his agents are suspicious that during their meetings [character] has turned [character] against you and that there is a planned attempt on your life. A servant approaches to inform you that [character] is at the palace, asking to meet with you alone. [character] gives you a meaningful look. There is no time for proof, can [character] be trusted?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Truce

options.text: Agree to peace.
No, that is enough.

events.text: A messenger arrives at your court from [character], praising your glory and devoutness. In front of the gathered nobles, he states that after the words of [character] on your behalf, [character] wants to unite the people of [rival] and [rival] under a peace of the [religion] faithful. There are murmurs of curiosity amongst those listening but the [family] family are quick to take the floor, decrying this attack on [rival] values and independence.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Is This All There Is to Life?

options.text: And yet, the sheer distraction becomes more essential by the day.

events.text: Each evening of supposed delights seems to blur into the next.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Laches

tip: As leader: +5% Unit Trait Modifier / Melee
As general: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Melee

options.text: [character] will learn to fight without armor.

tip: As leader: +5% Unit Trait Modifier / Ranged
As general: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Ranged

options.text: [character] will learn to fight with armor.
Bravery is but one part of virtue.
Actually, we should all go back to training.

events.text: [character] approaches you and notes that he is engaged in a debate with [character] about how [character] should be learning in his tactics studies, whether to learn to fight with armor or without it. While [character] believes that learning to fight without armor is the best way to foster bravery, [character] insists that fighting with armor better prepares one for military duties and battlefield tactics. They turn to you for advice on how to proceed.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Land Grab

options.text: This is an excellent development.

events.text: After many restless nights, [character]'s agents return from their mission to infiltrate the lands of [rival]. Our spies secured numerous pieces of intelligence, escaping the country without arousing any suspicion. In addition to their reconnaissance, the agents secured several areas of unpopulated land near our borders. With these seizures, [rival] will be able to continue its expansion.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Last Kiss

options.text: The whole [family] family is responsible for this treachery.
[rival] is better off without him.
This is none of my concern.

events.text: After a royal feast, [character] and [character] return to their estate for a relaxing evening. [character] kisses his husband, pulls a dagger from his robes, and stabs him through the heart. He exits the estate and disappears into the shadows before fleeing the country. It is widely accepted that he was paid to kill his husband.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Last Stand

options.text: Let this be a lesson to my enemies.

events.text: While preparing for a diplomatic trip to [rival], [character] notices a group of masked figures surrounding his home. They start a fire and wait in hiding as the flames rise high into the sky. With no way out, [character] races from the building with a dagger in hand. He is cut down by a storm of assassins' arrows.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Legal Dispute

options.text: [city] is a [family] city, so a property with disputed ownership is [family].
If the judge says the [family] are rightful owners of the property, so be it.
We can find a fair and just way for both families to share the property.
So much talk, so much chaos... turn it over to the common folk of [city].

events.text: A recent court case has turned into a major dispute. The cause is a property dispute between the [family] and the [family] in [city], the [family] family seat. The case went to the city's court where the judge was also [family]. Unsurprisingly, [family] said they would not recognize a ruling by a [family] judge in a [family] city. To everyone's great surprise, the judge ruled in favor of the [family] who are looking to accept the ruling, but now the [family] are calling foul play. Both families send representatives stating that they hold you in high esteem and ask for you to decide the dispute.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Lifestyles of the Rich

options.text: Send the cheats and plotters away!
A noble trading guild is a sound idea.
They have approval, but they must fund it themselves.

events.text: In court, members of the [family] family argue bitterly with the great merchant [character]. The [family] demand the formation of a noble trading guild that would grant lower prices and exclusivity on certain goods. If their demand is not granted, they will refuse to buy from royal vendors. [character] appears shaken by the threats.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Living in the Moment

options.text: Just don't think about the future.

events.text: It's easy, once you see clearly.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Local Authority

options.text: This was an unexpected failure.

events.text: Agents in [city] seek our immediate aid. Their plots to win over [character] were met with fierce resistance by the Governor’s paranoid inner circle, and they were imprisoned for suspected subterfuge. Furious at the defiance of his local authority, [character] holds a series of rallies, slandering you and the [rival] ruling court. He is turning the people of [city] against us.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Local Corruption

options.text: Those responsible must be purged and punished.
Allow [character] to choose how to handle this matter.
Punish some for show, and send all future gold to the throne.

events.text: As [character]'s agents work to ease tensions in [city], they discover a history of rampant local corruption. Judges, military officers, and politicians have built a convoluted bureaucratic nightmare for the city's citizens, skimming taxes to fill their own pockets. We must demand action from Governor [character]!

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Lover and Husband

options.text: Yes, yes, that sounds wonderful! Just put the knife away!
No. I will not bow to your wishes.
Ah my loves, you can't stop me.

events.text: Your lover, [character], whispering sweet nothings into your ear, blindfolds and binds you in your bedchamber, which smells of lavender and musk. A moment later, [character] removes the blindfold and greets you with a sight Eros might blush at. "My love, you've broken my heart with that request for a divorce, but [character] and I came to an understanding," [character] says and smiles wickedly, drawing a knife. "You can either marry us both, or one of us will hold you down while the other kills you. How does that sound, my love?"

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Luxurious Trade

options.text: We are not interested in anything except trade.

events.text: A trade delegation returns from [rival], bearing news that comes unexpectedly, but not unpleasantly. It seems that instead of a trade deal they wish to cultivate a new industry in [city]. They would provide the necessary essentials, while you would front the monetary expenses. It seems the climate of [city] is uniquely suited to this endeavor.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Luxurious Tribute
events.text: A humble delegation returns from [rival], bearing mountains of tribute. They abase themselves before you and present their best offerings last. They wish to cultivate a new industry in [city]. Furthermore, they offer to provide the necessary essentials and pay you for the privilege. It seems the climate of [city] is uniquely suited to this endeavor.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Making Marriage Work

options.text: I love you too!

events.text: [character], my husband, I never thought I would find love in our marriage but I am glad that I have.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Making Marriage Work

options.text: I will do my best to keep this in mind.

events.text: Your husband doesn’t particularly enjoy your company, but then, who can blame him? He didn’t ask to be married to you. It’s time to change that and start making an effort to get to know him. “Husband, what makes you happy?” He replies, “<p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_ARCHETYPE_REGAL>I want to learn, to grow, to create!<p=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_ARCHETYPE_MARTIAL>To struggle, to overcome, to win!<p=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_COVERT>To outwit everyone else and make them dance to my tune!<else>I don’t know, perhaps just getting compliments?<end>”

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Market Unrest

options.text: Establish organized guilds across [rival].
Invest in trade reform in [city].
Assemble a council to review monetary laws.
There is nothing we can do right now.

events.text: Civil unrest in the markets of [city] threaten to erupt across the empire. Our refusal to form trade guilds has roiled the public. The [family] family has asked the court to reconsider our decision against allowing merchants to band together for better prices and more control. Something must be done before our economy suffers.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Mercantile Metal

options.text: Instruct them to make the deal.
Push for more of the simple Iron instead.
For now, we prefer not to trade.

events.text: Upon reaching [rival] your trade mission discovers a precious resource, a fine steel that the locals smelt through a process that leaves dark ripples spreading across the metal like disturbances in water. After some negotiation, they suspect it is possible to open trade for a supply of this Wootz Steel.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Misinformation

options.text: Undermine the local and national leadership.
Cause confusion and discord among the people.

events.text: Among [character]'s agents in [city] are several former scholars who have dedicated themselves to the security of our beloved [rival]. They have envisioned a plot to spread misinformation about the city's leadership. Distributing written propaganda and giving speeches in the marketplaces, they are able to strike [city] where it's most vulnerable. Where should they focus their efforts?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Missing the Mark

options.text: Perhaps gold can buy peace?
We will not be threatened.

events.text: [character] brings dire news that your assassin was killed before managing to kill [character]. The [rival] leaders are shocked that you would attempt such a brazen act against one of their subjects, and an ambassador arrives from [character]. Her steely gaze brokers no argument as she demands that you either pay tribute for the crime to barter a truce, or face war.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Money Management

options.text: To haggle with merchants to bring prices down.
To search carefully for the very lowest prices.

events.text: [character] asks [character] to accompany him to the market for a lesson in money management. While browsing the stalls, [character] encourages his young charge to get the best bargains. What shall he teach [character]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Monkey Assassin

options.text: That went surprisingly well!

events.text: It is time for the ultimate test of whether your plan will work! One of your agents sneaks the monkey into the grounds of [character] home, releasing it with a small vial of poison. The well trained monkey darts in through the window without a second glance, the agent left to wait in tense anticipation. A minute later the monkey returns, the agent quickly knocking the apple from its mouth. After hearing the shocked cries as the body is found, the two steal back into the night to report their success.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Monkey Assassin

options.text: I should have seen that coming...

events.text: It is time for the ultimate test of whether your plan will work. One of your agents takes the monkey to the grounds of [character] home, releasing it with a small vial of poison. Your monkey darts in through the window without a backwards glance, but it only takes a moment for things go terribly, terribly wrong. The agent winces listening to the crashes and commotion throughout the house, and soon a plume of smoke starts to trail from the building as a fire caused by the hapless monkey catches the rafters. The agent reports that he saw people stream out of the building, [character] amongst them, badly burned but alive. The monkey was never seen again.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Monkey of Truce

options.text: I’ll be glad to be rid of the thing.
“Creature”? That monkey is family!

events.text: Word arrives from [rival] that they are willing to agree to a Truce, but the conditions are somewhat unusual. events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Naming and Necessity

options.text: Sure thing.
Your name is [character], come along now.

events.text: [character] can barely contain his excitement and pride at being chosen for the royal house of [rival]. He looks at you, eyes serious, and says "I shall now be known as Shadowlightning, Foe of the Unworthy!"

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: National Treasure

options.text: This armor will be mine. Do what you must.
Your mission is too important, [character]. Stay true to your task.

events.text: While setting up a network of agents in [city], [character] hears of an artifact held in a vault in the center of the city: A legendary set of armor said to belong to of [rival]. It is a treasure of national fame and importance. [character] believes that his network has found an opening to steal this treasure for you. However, such an action would send the city into lockdown, making it impossible to set up a new network in the city.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Nero Escapes

options.text: Bid [character] to try again. [character] must be stopped.
Enough, we have failed.

events.text: [character] is constantly surrounded by sycophantic supporters, bodyguards, and even, so it appears, agents of his own. Forewarned of the attack in the nick of time, [character] is able to escape unharmed. Although he makes no public move against you, you fear that the Emperor-to-be now knows that you move against him.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Never Enough

options.text: We should start production in [rival].
It is better to continue importing such comforts.
I will no longer pay for the [family] bad habits.

events.text: Sometimes too much is never enough. The insatiable [character] and his family, unsatisfied with their lives of plenty, have petitioned the court for even more imports to slake their lust for fine goods. The constant consumption and wanton spending is taking its toll on the treasuries. One option to remedy the [family] greed would be to increase production of these items inside [rival]. Or we could continue to ship them in from afar for our vassal families.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: No More Secrets

options.text: The throne is responsible for this failure.
Clearly, the agent was not up to the task.

events.text: An ominous message arrives from [rival]. It seems that [character]'s agent has been captured and tortured by members of the [rival] military, and he has revealed many of the court's most confidential plans. The next morning, the agent's decapitated body is discovered on the road to [city].

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: No Time Wasted

options.text: "From here on"? You do know that I have no intention of stepping aside any time soon?
You know what, let's get to work on planning that coronation.

events.text: "You have made the right choice." [character] assures you. "I know it should be a weight off your shoulders that you have someone with vision and diligence to take the reins from here on."

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: No Truce

options.text: Perhaps they are not as naive as we thought.

events.text: Bad news from the front. We have been informed by an envoy from [rival] that it is not in their best interests to accept a truce under any condition.

events.name: No War Declaration

options.text: Oh, how generous of them to prioritize their own needs over ours!

events.text: Regrettably, the [rival] have made it clear that declaring war on [rival] is not aligned with their interests.

options.text: We can only rely on ourselves now.

events.triggerData: Ask a Nation to Declare War on a Tribe

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: No Zealot Like the Convert

options.text: Help to fund his efforts.
Thank him for trying.
How foolish, that money can be better spent for the people of [city].

events.text: Your attempts to convert [character] to [religion] have gone better than expected. Filled with fervor for, he has taken to the streets of [city], paying for new shrines and holy sites out of his own pocket. However, [character] has run out of funds, and comes to you asking for support from the state. Will you fund his conversion efforts in [city]?
events.triggerData: Convert Target to State Religion Event

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Noble Concerns

options.text: We should support the [family] Family as they support our actions.
Arrange for the [family] Family to receive a large shipment of food.
A gift of iron for the [family] Family would bring those daggers to our side.

events.text: [character] stops you outside the throne room, informing you of malicious whispers among the families about your recognition of the former bastard [character]. "It seems the [family] are in favor of the action, but the [family] don't like it on legal grounds, while the [family] have their knives out. It's a right mess all around as always." How shall we turn this to our advantage?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Nobles Abroad

options.text: We must keep a close eye on the [family].

events.text: While infiltrating the Cities and villages of [rival], [character]'s agents encounter several traveling members of the [family] family. Knowing the [family] love of wine, our agents work to loosen the nobles' tongues. After a night of revels, our agents learn that [character] and some of the other [family] are plotting to usurp the throne.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Of Dogs and Daggers

options.text: What kind of monster would do such a thing!

events.text: Late one evening, you enter your chambers. As you change out of the royal regalia, your faithful furry companion rests upon your bed in the next room. Suddenly, a low growl rumbles from your dog, followed by the sounds of a ferocious brawl and pained yelp. You rush into your bedroom, and find your dog dead on the floor, a dagger embedded in it's side with a note around the handle. The note contains a single line, "I have killed your assassin and your dog, consider yourself warned." You know this must be the work of [character].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: On War

options.text: We are ready for this.
There are more preparations to be made.

events.text: You read the treatise as you consider your plans against [rival]: “War is as easy to lose as it is to win. It is fickle, unpredictable, and expensive. Know your forces, know your enemies, know the consequences and know the right time and the right place. Then march in full force, or do not march at all.”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Only the Best

options.text: [character] will marry [character].
[character] is the right choice.
Neither of these options are good enough.

events.text: It has been months of negotiation with the [family], but your skills as a have secured the finest of matches for [character]. Do either of the final two [family] suitors meet your standards?

events.text: It has been months of negotiation with [tribe], but your skills as a have secured the finest of matches for [character]. Do either of the final two [tribe] suitors meet your standards?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Ostracized

options.text: There is no compelling evidence against [character].
We have no choice but to cast out the villain!
Refute the charges against [character].

events.text: After several contentious encounters, the [family] family accuses the [family] of political wrongdoing, specifically [character]. They request that all citizens of [city] write the name of someone on the court whom they wish to see "ostracized." They have chosen [character]. We have not seen evidence of his crimes, but the accusers have whipped the population into a frenzy. They want blood.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Our Allegiance

options.text: All serve Ahura Mazda in the battle against evil.
They fight for the good of [rival] and its ruler.
We are done following the whims of faith.

events.text: Murmurs of discontent can be heard in military camps across [rival]. With the rise of [religion], many of its adherents claim that they are "soldiers for Ahura Mazda". Such a bold statement unnerves the other men, who have pledged allegiance to you, [character]. For whom do our armies fight? Our [title], or our god?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Our City

options.text: The [family] may have [city].
They ask too much!
Convince them that [city] is a joyless burden.

events.text: Members of the [family] wish to meet with the Council in private, away from prying eyes. Privately, they present a list of complaints and grievances, threatening to oppose future policies if the treatment of their family does not change. As recompense, they demand that we give them full authority over the city of [city].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Out of Touch

options.text: He is dead to us.

events.text: For several weeks, communication with [character] has been slow, challenged by a series of weather events and a shortage of messengers. But only when the latest update arrives do we learn the truth: [character] has defected to the [rival] court. With our Agent goes any plot for Insurrection.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Outdoor Lesson

options.text: Learning to identify and track wildlife.

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Mounted
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Mounted

options.text: Mastering the art of horseback riding.

events.text: A beautiful morning dawns in [city], and [character] prepares to take [character] out for his daily lesson. How shall [character] spend this sunny day in the wild?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Overlooked Innovators

options.text: Promote this man above his superiors.
I will take the time to listen.

events.text: Moved by your electrifying oration in [city], a small group of soldiers seeks a private audience. They wish to share several scientific developments created during their time in training. Their leader, a frail, well-spoken swordsman, explains that their group has been scoffed at by officers and ridiculed by fellow troops. No one will listen to their ideas. Will you?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Pacifism

options.text: No, I must find another way.
I will no longer hold myself to such ideals.

events.text: Committing to war will bring more violence, destruction, and bloodshed. Is this the path you choose?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Parted by Death

options.text: Close up the loose end.
There has been enough death already.

events.text: Your assassins have done their morbid work, slaying [character] on the steps of his home. However, things are by no means over. In the days leading up to his death, [character] shared his fears and suspicions with his husband, [character]. [character] has locked himself away since the murder. It may be grief, but your agents suspect that [character] is plotting his revenge. It would be tough to get to him, but your assassins believe they can finish the job.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Paternal Custody

options.text: Order soldiers to take by children by force.
Declare [character] and [character] to be illegitimate.
Identify loopholes in the law that deny him custody.

events.text: When your husband receives your demand for a divorce, he collects your children, [character] and [character] and retreats to his Family's estate in [city]. Shortly afterwards, you receive a message from one of his servants. "I hereby exert my paternal rights over the custody of our children. They will remain in my care."

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Patriarch vs. Oligarch

options.text: [character] is right, [character] ought to convert.
[character] may keep his [religion] faith.

events.text: [character], the head of your State Religion of [religion], has been debating theology with [character], Oligarch of the [family] Family and a devout [religion]. [character] believes that having a non-[religion] among the Heads of our great Family constitutes a crisis of faith for our nation, and he is insistent that [character] convert to [religion]. [character], however, is quite content with his [religion] faith, and sees no need to bow to the [religion] establishment of [rival]. Both of them have now confronted you with this squabble in the royal palace. Will you tolerate the [religion] ways of [character], or pressure him to convert to your State Religion?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Pay to Play

options.text: He will do his duty... as a public service.
A small dispensation cannot hurt.
Agree, but he is now my agent.

events.text: [character] has approached the court treasurer, requesting that he be paid for his services. Apparently, he has acquired significant debt and requires new sources of income. It is not the government's practice to pay its courtiers. Accepting [character]'s request may set an expensive precedent.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Payout

options.text: Luck never holds, in the long run. There is no better time to stop.
Nothing can stop me, now that I'm on a roll.

events.text: This is it. The perfect night, the perfect streak of decisions and luck. Near enough every coin in the house making its way to your side of the table.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Peace Among The Faithful

options.text: We will seek better relations with the [rival].
We have no desire to change our diplomatic relationship with the [rival].

events.text: [character] has visited the High Synod of [religion], but the [religion] council is less than pleased with us. The [religion] elders want there to be peace among the faithful, and yet we are not on the friendliest terms with the [rival]. In fact, the [religion] elders are demanding that we attempt to come to terms with the [rival], and reach out to them with an offer of Player Peace.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Peace Proposal

options.text: Let a gift of tribute show our goodwill.
Peace is desirable.
We demand a tribute before any peace.
Maybe later.

events.text: It is time for a closer relationship with [character] and [rival], more than just a Truce. How shall we ask for a lasting Peace?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Peace Proposal

options.text: Yes.
No.

events.text: [rival] envoy arrives with a Peace proposal. What do you say?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Peace Response

options.text: We leave [rival] to its fate.

events.text: A riderless horse delivers a short, one-word response from the [rival]: "Never." They certainly have a flair for the dramatic.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Peace Response

options.text: This is an acceptable agreement.
It is not enough.

events.text: We have summoned the [rival] leadership to court to deliver a message: we are willing to explore a truce, but they must agree to our demands.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Peace Response

options.text: Peace will do.
This is not the time.

events.text: [rival] riders arrive in the capital, requesting an audience with the court. They have come to deliver another request for peace. How shall we respond?

events.name: Peace Response

This is unacceptable.

events.text: After years of growing tension, [rival] has finally sent a messenger to offer peace, but at a price... Do we dare defy them?
