events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Planetary Influence

options.text: We will use this to predict the seasonal effects on our crops.
Alignment with the stars will bring order to our construction.
With this we can divine the proper times to commune with the gods.

events.text: The astronomer [character] is happy to spend time with you, as long as you listen to his findings. The results are surprisingly informative. he has divided the night sky into segments, groups of stars that can be tracked as they move and regularly appear and disappear.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Poisoned

options.text: It doesn't matter who did it, but rather where it happened.
I've heard rumors that [character] might wish my death.
No. I don't know who it could be.

events.text: While you dine with [character] and [character], you notice the wine seems to have a lingering odor of bitter almonds and parsnips. As you leave the villa you collapse, vomiting blood and bile. When you awake, in bed, blackness clouds the edges of your vision. A kindly gray-eyed court doctor stares into your eyes, his brow creased with worry lines. "My [title], you've been poisoned. Frankly, it's a miracle you are breathing at all. Someone wants you dead. Have you any idea who?" It seems your attempt to assassinate [character] has backfired.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Pretty Persuasion

options.text: I have received the [family] message. Release [character].
Justice in court will not be bought and sold.
Keep the riches and uphold the arrest. The [family] are fools.

events.text: You have only just given the order for [character]'s arrest, when a strange servant arrives at your chamber door laden with a heavy sack. She bows courteously and leaves the sack with you. Peering inside, you discover a small trove of glittering gold and gems. The stamp of the noble house of [family] has been branded into the sack's fine goatskin. It is a reminder of the power this family wields over every decision - even yours.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Progress and Prosperity

options.text: Help the [tribe] fund a caravan and share in the profits.
Make a sizeable donation to the coffers of the [tribe].
Gift [character] with access to your military planners and civil engineers.
Sadly, at present, we are not in a position to take advantage of any other opportunities.

events.text: Your efforts at diplomacy with the [tribe] have begun to bear fruit and your latest effort has created a few different opportunities you might use as leverage to further improve relations, or at the very least, gain benefits for your Realm. You need but decide on a specific course of action.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Protected by the People

options.text: Throw a huge celebration to thank of the people of [city].
Have the execution take place in front of the gathered mob.

events.text: The [rival] plans to start an insurrection in [city] did not go as they expected. When their agent [character] tried to rile the crowd against you, the people instead turned on the hapless instigator in a rather dramatic display of loyalty to you. Marching to the palace, the people throw the agent before your throne with calls for his blood. Will you make an example of [character], or focus on thanking the people while he quietly 'disappears'.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Proud Throngs

options.text: We should always celebrate our brave soldiers.

events.text: In an effort to inspire your forces, you visit every city in [rival], speaking before throngs of eager soldiers. The gatherings attract proud citizens, who openly share their food and drink with the assembled crowds. The tour proves a rousing success, one with unintended benefits. Both [city] and [city] still ring with celebrations days after your departure.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Quality Time

options.text: The night is young.

events.text: It is a genuine pleasure to spend time with your husband, and tonight you have time for a quiet meal together with all his favorite foods, some wine, and a delicious dessert. Afterwards, who knows what might happen?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Quality Time

options.text: The night is young.

events.text: It is a genuine pleasure to spend time with your husband, and tonight you have time for a quiet meal together with all his favorite foods, some wine, and a delicious dessert. Afterwards, who knows what might happen?

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Rapid Disposal

options.text: A tragedy, to be sure.
Offer condolences to the [family].

events.text: It came together perfectly. [character] got a bit too close to the river. All he needed was a little push before being swept away and lost among the rapids of the indifferent [event] waters.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Recognition of Lover

options.text: This offer has merit, and we shall accept it.
No. The last embers of my love faded years ago.
I've only ever wanted you, my love.

events.text: Early in the morning, [character] comes to you with an offer. He asks that you not divorce him, which would subject both of you to the wrath of his Family. Instead, he suggests that you remain married to him, while also taking on your lover [character] as an additional husband. Shall we accept this offer?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Rejection of Influence

options.text: To arms! Kill the intruders!
Allow [character] to leave. He has made his point.
I hear you, and I apologize for my part in it.

events.text: A dozen armed guards storm into the court. [character] leads the force, fury and anger blaze in his eyes. "Damn you to hell [character], you bastard! I'll not be paid off by the likes of you! This feud will end one way or another!" How shall we respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Religious Teachings

options.text: Do not rest until you understand the deepest ideas of [religion].
Ask them to teach you enough for daily practice.
Refuse to pay the priests.

events.text: As much as you have tried, an understanding of the ideas at the heart of [religion] continue to elude you. A small delegation of approach you, offering to tutor and guide you into the intricacies of the esoteric knowledge… for a price.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Rule of Law

options.text: The ruler is the final judge of what is right.
Authority rests with the consensus of the court.
Judges and orators speak for the people.

events.text: For several days in a row, [character] takes his young student, [character], to the city courts to observe legal proceedings. When asked about his opinions on the law's influence over politics, [character] responds.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Ruler of All

options.text: I am equal to the Emperors of the east.
All Kings shall bow before me.
I need no more titles to show my prowess.

events.text: The [tribe] have fallen before you, agreeing to join the [rival] federation under the threat of your might. They are not the first to fall before the [rival] and nor will they be the last. As your power and influence grows, you consider adopting a new title to reflect your successes, looking to your established neighbors for examples for monarchical titles.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Sage Counsel

options.text: Reduce the backlog of legal cases.
Train additional advocates.
Find ways to improve efficiency.

events.text: Recent policy changes have expedited legal matters across the kingdom, leaving many advocates with new-found availability. We should put these experts to task. How shall these scholars direct their efforts?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Schemes Exposed

options.text: I suppose all that matters now is victory.

events.text: Your attempts to oust [character] may not have been as subtle as you had hoped. The very night you expected to hear word of his sad, yet untraceable, demise... you instead hear the sound of armed clashes through the streets of [city]. [rival] is at war with itself. Did your attempt on [character] life simply accelerate his treasonous schemes... or did you create the Civil War by forcing his hand?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Secret Lovers

options.text: Reveal this scandalous affair to agitate the rebels.
I will help the young lovers keep their secret.

events.text: While investigating ways to turn the people of [city] against their rulers, [character] uncovers a shocking piece of information: [character], the young [rival] Heir, has been seen in the company of our own [character]. It appears that the two youths are engaged in a secret love affair in defiance of their Family and nations. We could use this gossip to further our interests in [city], though at the expense of our standing with the [family].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Seditious Meetings

options.text: Arrest [character] on charges of treason against [rival].
The court should investigate political reform in [city].

requirements.label: Charming character / Inspiring / Blessed
tip: The leader must have one of: Charming character (a character trait); Inspiring; Blessed

options.text: I will speak to these gatherings in person.

events.text: Citizens of [city] have reported secret meetings held by followers of [character], during which he gives seditious speeches against your rule. These regular events have driven up resentment in the capital, and the court worries about their enduring effects. We should intervene now, before conditions worsen.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Seeking Help

options.text: I wish him a speedy recovery.

events.text: Our agent in [rival] has returned triumphant, bearing caches of scientific research. Unfortunately, the stressful experience has taken its toll on [character]. He has chosen to leave the Council and seek the healing power of the temple. We will need to find a new spymaster.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Selling Secrets

options.text: You never can trust a spy.

events.text: Months have passed since [character] sent his agent into [rival] to steal its scientific secrets. Finally, news of his betrayal begin to trickle in from other sources. Instead of stealing knowledge from the [rival], our spy sold them our secrets for an astronomical sum, after which he crossed into the wilds to the east and disappeared.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Selling Stirrups

options.text: We can not miss this golden opportunity.
Push [rival] for a better deal.
The military advantage is too great to pass up.

events.text: As your people adjust to using stirrups and the control it brings over a horse, [character] brings to your attention the trade opportunities that this evolving technology brings. The original toe loops have been increasingly replaced by a platform formed of a metal hook. Small and simple to make, yet still requiring the know-how, the new style of hook stirrups could be a lucrative source of trade. Not all are so willing to trade away this knowledge; [character] and the other Generals are wary of giving away the military advantage that this new find could bring to [rival].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Send Him Out!

options.text: We will give them [character].
They ask for too much. Teach them obedience.
I will meet with leaders of the rebellion.

events.text: The bumbling arrival of [character]'s agents in [city] inspires open rebellion in the streets. Crowds grow violent, torching dwellings and attacking [rival] guards. The leaders of the rabble call for the Chancellor to be handed over to them. If not, they will continue their destructive march across the city and beyond.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Setting an Example

options.text: This kind of idleness in the people is unacceptable. Conscript every able bodied [rival] you can find in the gambling halls.
Perhaps the laws among the common folk should be relaxed. It is only fair.
A lack of enforcement has benefits.

events.text: It has become an open secret that the [title] has a keen interest in games of chance, and around the capitol, business in the still-illegal vice is surging.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Settlement Demand

options.text: I will pay the settlement for [character].
I withdraw my request for a divorce.
I will rid myself of [character] one way or another.

events.text: When [character] receives your written request for a divorce, he springs into action, alerting his entire extended Family, including [character]. Outraged by what he views as an illegal action, [character] demands that you pay a settlement to [character] immediately. If you do not accept, he claims the divorce will be unlawful and unacceptable.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Sharing the Blessing

options.text: Dedicate yourself to convincing the elders to welcome [religion].
Let the elders decide what is good for their city.
Call on the laws of tolerance to allow [religion] to spread.

events.text: The ideas of [religion] have taken hold and are constantly on your mind after studying and trying to learn their practices. As you convert yourself, you question if it might be wise to encourage the spread of the religion in your nation too. The elders of [city] seem resistant to allowing [religion] to spread to their city from superstition and fear.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Silver Linings

options.text: Something is better than nothing.

events.text: An update arrives from [character]. Unable to complete their infiltration mission, his agents attempted to make the journey worth their efforts. Visiting [rival] mines and farms along the border, they procured a supply of foreign delicacies for the return home. At least the expedition was not a total failure.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Small Gestures and Time

options.text: I promise!

events.text: Your efforts to influence [character] have finally borne fruit. He has been disappointed with you for some time, but your efforts to win back his good will with small gestures of friendship over time has resulted in a brief, friendly meeting with [character]. “It was good to see you again, [character]. Just don’t let me down again,” he says as he leaves.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Spreading the Faith

options.text: We will consider sending Disciple to convert the [tribe] to [religion].

events.text: A message arrives from the High Synod of [religion]: "We are delighted that you have sent [character] to visit us, as we have been meaning to speak with you about a pressing matter. You are not at War with the godless [tribe], and yet you have made no effort to bring the light of [religion] to those heathen tribesmen. We task you with sending a Disciple to the [tribe] to convert them to [religion]. If you do this, we will be greatly pleased with you."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Spy vs. Spy

options.text: I have already invested too much in this mission.
Direct our agents to befriend the young Heir.
We may need to remove [character], if it comes to that.

events.text: Our agents in [rival] have found it difficult to make contact with [character], encountering strong resistance in the form of a spy network run by his heir, [character]. Any attempts to sway [character]'s opinion have failed, although [character]'s interest seems piqued by this game of intrigue. This may be an unexpected opportunity to endear ourselves to [character], the rising heir, but we would need to tread lightly.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Standing Armies

outcomes.label: Rally Standing Armies Repair Four Improvements
Rally Standing Armies Repair Eight Improvements

options.text: They will join laborers in the procurement of materials.
We need more troops to enforce the peace.
Cities need more defensive fortifications.

events.text: Inspired by your speeches, soldiers across [rival] intensify their drills and combat training. When they are not honing their military prowess, they dedicate their time and energies to improving the Cities in which they live. Thousands of fighting men and women take to the streets to volunteer their time. Officers have appealed to the court for direction. How shall soldiers focus their labors?

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Steal Away

options.text: Kill the hostage. Our message should be clear.
That is a less subtle approach than I expected, but the hostage may prove valuable.
[character] is a fool. Return the hostage before more damage is done.
Bring our guest to me. We may yet have a place for them.

events.text: During [character]’s time in [city], he has managed to gain the trust and friendship of one of [rival]’s key nobles. While the two are out on an unaccompanied airing in the woods near [city], [character] sees an opportunity to steal away with his companion at knife point. Word soon arrives that [character] has returned to [city] with his hostage. What is to be done about the situation?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Strangled!

options.text: Indulge [character]'s suspicions.
Give [character] your vote of confidence.

events.text: [character] is discovered dead in his bath. After examining the body, doctors believe that he was strangled. [character]'s husband, [character], accuses [character] of carrying out this heinous act. "The two were close, but they had recently suffered a falling out."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Strike at the Heart

options.text: Attack those in line at recruitment centers.
Set fire to military buildings and barracks.

events.text: Completing his assignments with admirable speed, [character] proceeds to enact plots to damage the growing [rival] might. He gathers a team of resourceful spies and soldiers to strike at the heart of their military. [character] is eager to launch these efforts, but he needs to know what locations to target.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Stubborn as a Mule

options.text: Encourage the whole family to apply pressure.
A simple application of charm always works.
Advise the use of fear and threats to break down his walls.
Abandon the effort.

events.text: [character] has sunk his heels in, refusing to listen to [character] entreaties to talk. The dejected [title] returns, seeking advice on how best to proceed. How should [character] continue this intercession?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Successful Mission

options.text: It is about time he came around.

events.text: Agents sent by [character] to malign the [rival] leadership report success, causing much optimism in the court. [character] of the [family] is especially pleased. [character] has long been a critic of your leadership, but this latest triumph seems to be convincing him of your views.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Surprise Benefactor

options.text: Equipment and materials would be appreciated.
He could use some political connections.
The cost of private tutors continues to rise...

events.text: We are pleased to report that [character] has responded favorably to our attempts to dispel the animosity between you. In fact, he has chosen to show additional goodwill by making a generous contribution to the education of your Heir, [character]. This is an noble gesture, and we should make the most of it.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Suspicions Confirmed

options.text: Welcome him back to court with a speech.
Investigate rumors of corruption in the military.
Convince [character] that I am not involved.

events.text: While waiting in the street for his servants to fetch him, [character] is attacked by a man dressed as a soldier in the [rival] army. He manages to escape, and the would-be assassin is captured by the city guards. [character] is more convinced than ever that someone is plotting his murder.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Tables Turn

options.text: And somehow, none of that tells you when the knives will come out.

events.text: A misplaced word or a turncoat. Someone has let slip to [character] your plans. You know this, of course, through your own turncoat. So, now you dance. You know that he knows that you know that he knows, and so on, past the point of madness.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Taking it Personally

options.text: Raise the alarms! Prepare the troops!

events.text: Mere hours after informing your husband of your divorce, you receive a knock on your door. [character] has gathered his most devoted servants and left [city] for [tribe] lands. It is not long before spies inform the court of movement along the border. The [tribe] have taken the affront to [character] very personally, and they are thirsty for vengeance.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Technological Tribute

options.text: Accept this gift of knowledge.
Then we will take it by force!

events.text: The [rival] swiftly reply to your demand for tribute, although the answer is not as clear-cut as hoped. Blaming a lack of funds and claiming that they have little to share, the nation has offered a gift of technology instead. They insist that they need to hold onto what few resources they have. Is this offering enough to placate you?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: The Bastard's Body

options.text: We must launch an investigation into the murder.
Leave the matter alone. Further investigation will only bring heartache.
It is plain to see. [character] is the vile murderer!

events.text: The body of [character] is found at the bottom of a rocky ravine. Suspicions surround his untimely death, which may stem from envy over his recent legitimization. He was last seen in the gardens with [character], the evening before his body was discovered. Shall we investigate?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Cadaver Synod

options.text: [character] must be struck from the records.
Side with the dissenting voice.

events.text: The [religion] High Synod has taken a rather unexpected turn. Once the required are all gathered, [character] proceeds to bring out the exhumed body of [character] and places the once-Patriarch on trial for charges of sedition and perjury. The members of the Synod seem convinced of their previous leader's guilt, although a lone dissenter suggests that the religion should use this example to demonstrate the power of Redemption through the <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_ZOROASTRIANISM>fires of Ahura Mazda<p=SUBJECT_CHRISTIANITY>death of Christ<p=SUBJECT_JUDAISM>laws of the Torah<p=SUBJECT_MANICHAEISM>wisdom of Mani<else>prayers of the faithful<end>. The lone asks you to intervene. Will you practice forgiveness, or strip the dead of his titles?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Captured Agent

options.text: Give him freedom in return for [rival] secrets.
Spare [character] in return for his loyalty.
There is no mercy for agents and spies.

events.text: [character] guards have managed to capture [character], [rival] Agent nested in [city], while he was attempting to flee from the city. [character] makes a plea for mercy, claiming to have been coerced into the role of a spy. He offers information if you are willing to make a deal. [character] suggests that [character] could be put to good use, but can this foreign agent be trusted?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The City Steps

options.text: He would make a good governor.
We will keep an eye on this man of the people.
The royal treasury will invest in [city]'s ongoing debate.

events.text: On a recent visit to the city of [city], [character] and his retinue encounter a throng of angry citizens crowding the city market. A series of impassioned speakers decry the poor conditions of [city] and their effects on the people. Between speeches, [character] climbs the steps and gives a calming oration, addressing the grievances and assuring support.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Cost of Loyalty

options.text: If you will not serve, your successor will.
We will pay the price.

events.text: [character] stands defiant before you. Although the [tribe] have little choice but to bow to your overwhelming might, the extreme distaste for your rule means that they will not accept quietly.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Cycle Continues

options.text: We must be vigilant in the days ahead.

events.text: News reaches you that your assassins hit their mark, chasing down and slaughtering [character]. What they didn’t see was his son watching from behind a column, frozen in fear. Twisted by anger and grief, [character] is consumed with getting vengeance for the murder of his father. Mere days later, your heir [character] is assaulted when traveling through the city at night, barely escaping with his life.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: The Dance of Diplomacy

options.text: Give [character] food to distribute to his people.
Offer to provide engineering expertise to [character]
Make a show of negotiating a settlement that will solve both problems while providing a gain to your own Realm as well, then reverse course and make a gift of our resources.
Alas, at present we are not in a position to take advantage of these intelligences.

events.text: Your attempts to improve relations with the [tribe] have given you significantly greater insight into the needs of their people, which in turn, has created a new diplomatic opportunity. You have learned, for example, that due to relatively poor harvests, the [tribe] are a bit short on food. You've also learned that [character] is scrambling to find the resources to undertake some important engineering products he has been trying to get off the ground. You could help with both, or neither...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Drunken Army

options.text: I should be more careful with my wine.

events.text: You are met with cheers as you arrive at the military training grounds. Servants unload wagons of fine food and wine for the soldiers, and you toast their courage and good health. Revels continue late into the night. The next day, you discover that General [character] and his men have started training while still inebriated from the previous evening's festivities. Several of the troops sustain injuries in the resulting drills, and [character] must retire to his tent to recover.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: The Favored Family

options.text: The court will do all it can for the [family] family in the name of [religion]
We cannot lend our support right now.

events.text: The High Synod of [religion] is pleased that you have reached out to the faith, sending a delegation to your court to improve relations. During their visit, they propose that we should show special favor to the [family], as they are devout adherents of [religion]. Diverting funds to the [family] would show the followers of [religion] that the throne means to support them.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Fighting Class

options.text: Permit the fighting class to form an assembly.
Reevaluate our laws for better representation.
Provide the masses with a short-lived distraction.

events.text: A column of militiamen winds its way through [city] to the royal palace, interrupting a political debate. After years of living at the mercy of the court, they demand representation. These men, mostly farmers, are made to spend years away from their homes in times of war, leaving their families to ruin, and all at the whim of the ruling class. They demand a seat in court, or at the very least the ability to elect their own officials.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Finger

options.text: Return the finger to his family.

outcomes.label: Insurrection The Finger Ambition Six Agents
Insurrection The Finger Ambition Four Agent Networks

events.text: After befriending several outspoken [rival] rebels, [character] agrees to meet with their leader in a secret location. Unfortunately, the meeting is a trap. When [character] arrives, several members of the elite [rival] army await him. The military has been working to root out dissidents for months. The last message you receive from [character] is written in someone else's hand, and it includes a severed finger wrapped in cloth.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Forgotten Prophet

options.text: Try to find other texts that mention the prophet.
Ignore the strange phrase.

events.text: While poring through [religion] texts in an effort to understand your new religion, there is one passage that stands out as particularly strange. The text mentions [rival] prophet who. The prophet's name and words have been scratched from the tablet and there is no mention of in any of the other texts. Why would someone go to such lengths to erase this mysterious figure?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Gifted of Mani

options.text: Urge [character] to do such things in moderation.
Ignore the court’s concerns and allow him to continue on this path.

events.text: The training of [character] has been rather extreme, [character] forcing the convert to live by a strict schedule of prayer, meditation and fasting in order to deepen an understanding of the relation between the physical and spiritual worlds. But [character] does not seem to mind the new lifestyle, rather embracing it and researching the lives of ascetic philosophers and holy figures. The are impressed with [character] progress and dedication, but some of the court are concerned for the effect it could have on him and ask for you to intervene. Will you encourage this rejection of the physical?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Great Divide

options.text: Accept [character]’s decision.
Tell him to get over it.
Start planning to install [character] as the head of [religion].

events.text: [character] seems surprisingly open to adopting [religion], although there is a catch. “I understand that as [rival] it is my duty to support the State Religion. However, there is bad blood between myself and [character]. Sorry, but I cannot bring myself to accept [religion] with him as the head.” Will you accept [character]’s decision to not convert, or will you press the matter?
events.triggerData: Convert Target to State Religion Event

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: The Happy Couple

options.text: Love may always win, but few win this decisively.

events.text: At long last, no one, not even the [family] and [family] and their petty rivalries, can keep apart [character] and [character].

events.name: The Happy Couple

options.text: Love may always win, but few win this decisively.

events.text: At long last, no one, not even the [family] and [family] and their petty rivalries, can keep apart [character] and [character].

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: The Heart Grows Fonder

options.text: It’s good to have you back.

events.text: It has been too long since you have spoken to [character]. You miss him deeply. It is time to make amends. A series of careful messages have gotten you to the point where he has agreed to meet you during a minor banquet. You approach with some trepidation. “[character], please forgive me. I know I hurt you. I treated you poorly and that was wrong of me. I acted in a most unkingly manner.” He looks into your eyes for several moments, clearly thinking intently, before replying. “Very well, [character], you seem genuinely sorry and I’m willing to give you another chance. Don’t make me regret it.”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Help of Another

options.text: Offer to pay [character] to release the to work at your court.
Promise that you will return the favor for the's services.
The court cannot spare such expenses right now.

events.text: While studying the various [religion] practices, [character] had the help of a cohort of sent by [character]. [character] says that one in particular helped many of the finer points and boasts an impressive understanding of stately as well as religious matters. It may be possible to convince [character] to part with this talented … for a price.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: The High Synod

options.text: We will further intertwine our fate with the [religion].
Our initial gesture is sufficient for now.

events.text: [character] has visited the High Synod of [religion], offering to favor their religion. The [religion] council is pleased that we have finally come to recognize the legitimacy of their faith. In fact, the [religion] leaders seem amenable to further flattery.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Hunt Continues

options.text: The hunt is on!

events.text: Your guards move efficiently through [city] in their hunt for agents, following every lead and sweeping the city inch by inch. When they break into a suspected inn they find tablets with messages showing that, although there is no agent network in [city], one of their agents traveled through here recently, resting for a few days before traveling on to either [city] or [city]. One of these cities is likely occupied by an Agent Network. But which?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Laws of our God

options.text: Promise to seek the truth of [religion] together.
Send some of your finest scribes to tutor [character].
Pay a learned scholar to join the court.

events.text: While learning the practices of [religion] from [character], the newly converted [character] has found a passion for reading the religious texts. He now spends most days taking the esoteric interpretations of various scholars and translating them into. The eager learner has approached you, asking for help to pursue this new calling. Will you provide aid?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Lion

options.text: Allow him to learn about lions from scholarly reports.
Command him to examine the lion personally.

events.text: In a stroke of good luck, [character] has come into possession of a "lion" named Oliver, a rare exotic creature from the south. He wishes to use the beast in one of [character]'s science lessons, but the boy is reluctant. All it took was one look at the cat's enormous teeth. Shall we insist on this firsthand experience?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Lute Player

options.text: We will commission a song honoring [character].
The [family] have our deepest sympathies.

events.text: At a [family] birthday feast, a lute player sits before the assembled family to play a tune written for the occasion. Reaching the crescendo of the piece, the lute player stands and crushes the skull of [character] with a single blow. The celebration descends into chaos! As they recover the body of the slain assassin, the guards retrieve his lute. It is lined with a heavy bar of lead.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Queen's Claim

options.text: I don't care what she claims. It is not my child.
Tell the doctors to consult the calendars.
Give [character] some gold to change his story.

events.text: Within several days of your divorce, [character] claims that she is pregnant with a child of royal blood. Skeptical, you demand the truth of the child's parentage, but [character] will not change her story, and she refuses the divorce. How do you wish to deal with this predicament?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Schism of Marriage

options.text: Continue, no matter the cost.
Recant your request for a divorce.

events.text: Determined to remain [title], your spouse [character] has enlisted the help of [character] to try and thwart your attempts at a divorce. The [religion] [title] has united the and is threatening to spread discontent through their followers unless you agree to desist from this current course of action. Will religious intervention keep this marriage together?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Seer's Teachings

options.text: I'm sure [character] knows what he is doing.
Take a closer look at this troublesome quack.

events.text: [character] proves a compelling and intriguing teacher for the young [character]. His self effacing take on life and our place under the gods has had a marked effect on the impressionable pupil. As [character] steeps himself in these mystical teachings, you can't help but wonder if this education turn out the way you had hoped.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Slave King

options.text: Let [city] burn.

events.text: [character]'s actions to trigger a rebellion in [city] have proven too successful. Led by an inspiring youth who claims to be "chosen" by the gods, slaves in [city] have overthrown their masters. The city teems with violence, as [rival] nobles are murdered in the streets. Unable to escape the carnage, [character] falls to the mob.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Temptation of Marriage

options.text: Agree to convert to [religion].
Go ahead with the wedding, but refuse to convert.
Rethink the marriage plans.

events.text: Although receptive to your proposal of marriage, [character] has one caveat. The religious courtier asks that you convert to [religion], to which he has dedicated himself.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Things We Do

options.text: This is what it takes to rule.
I do what I must, even if I do not like it.

events.text: Your spymaster [character] brings news of the mission’s success. [character] has been slain with a mixture of hemlock, all without anyone knowing. You thank him for the news, before catching sight of your son [character] frozen in the entranceway, looking at you with a mixture of fear and disgust. How will you explain this to your compassionate son?

events.name: The Third Man

options.text: Make an offer to provide [rival] with the technology yourself.
Withdraw [character] in exchange for information.
Refuse to change your plans based on the [rival] spy.

[character] has explained that he is aiming to steal the [rival] plans for [tech]. [rival] is open to striking a deal if you are amenable to working together. If not, the glowering agent makes clear, then [rival] does not appreciate a rival network in the same city.

options.text: I will not back down. We fight!

options.text: I've got [character] right where I want him.

[character] staggers drunkenly in front of you with his fists up, as the court roars and yells obscenities while placing wagers on the fight. Your courage and honor demand that you accept this challenge, but maybe getting into this sort of situation is ill-advised? Should we change some things around the court so you don't end up in another drunken fistfight?

options.text: The world moves on the back of trade.

events.text: [character] has been impressed by the prosperity brought by our trade agreements and is quickly amenable to expanding the agreement to a formalized peace.

events.name: The Witness

options.text: Divorce is not good enough for [character].
Once I have signed, execute all the servants.
Leave him on an island to live his remaining days alone.
I will do nothing, rather than stoop to his level.

events.text: [character] receives the divorce document with characteristic resolve, requesting that witnesses be present at the signing. The next day, he arrives with a trio of servants to complete the agreement. As you prepare to sign your name, one of the servants lunges towards you with a dagger in his hand. The assassin is easily subdued, and he is forced to reveal the identity of the plotter: your husband, [character].

options.text: We must pay Tribute to the [tribe].

We will hold an emergency summit with [character].

events.text: A mob of rampaging [tribe] gallop into the city and confront the court guards, demanding an audience. It seems that [character] easily detected our agents and tortured them for information about our efforts to influence his affairs. Now he wants vengeance. [character] threatens to unleash his [tribe] warriors unless we offer atonement for our crimes.

events.name: Theological Letters

options.text: Yes, [character] is a good friend.
Maintain a light correspondence.
His acceptance of [religion] is enough.

events.text: Your attempts to convert [character] to [religion] have seen an unexpected side effect. While sending messages back and forth about different aspects of [religion], you have been surprised by the quality of your conversation. However, your scribes soon approach you complaining that [character] is sending longer and longer theological letters that are increasingly obscure and difficult to translate. Will you maintain this correspondence?

events.name: Thrown Roses

options.text: Our forces are ready for anything.
Allow my admirers to approach and touch me.

events.text: Soldiers of [rival] admire and respect your leadership, recognizing you as one of their own. Touring the streets of [city] on horseback, flanked by your royal guard, the cheering crowds bolster your spirit. A winding column of troops twists through the dusty streets. Flowers rain down upon your head throughout the entirety of your speech. You are adored.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Thus Spoke Zoroaster

options.text: The Avesta should be written down.
Keep the oral tradition alive.

events.text: For days, [character] and [character] have been locked in a heated debate over the future of [religion]. The words of Zoroaster have always been passed down orally, transmitted through the ages from follower to follower. [character] is suggesting that a copy should be written for the first time to record his words for future generations. [character] argues that writing is unworthy to record such holy words. The Magi are split and tensions are rising. Who do you side with?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Too Much Attention

options.text: I must refuse. He misunderstood by intentions.
If it will win over his Family, then I will do it.
Of course, but it will be our little secret.

events.text: After receiving numerous messages and visits from your servants, [character] has agreed to meet with you in an attempt to salvage your ailing relationship. "You have shown me much attention," [character] explains, entering your private chamber. "I am beginning to think you are fond of me." He touches your hand. "Perhaps we should pursue a new kind of relationship."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Tortured Assassin

options.text: We will try as many times as needed.
Get the assassin to tell you everything he learned about [character]'s defences.
Chastise [character] for allowing such a mistake.

events.text: Gasps echo through the hall as the man drags himself forwards, bloody and chained. You can see roughly stitched wounds criss-crossing his arms and few teeth left in the cracked mouth. [character] appears beside you and gravely whispers that it is the assassin that was sent to deal with [character]. As all but your most trusted are cleared from the room, the assassin approaches and confirms your suspicions - that he was caught and tortured before completing his task, and has now been sent back with a message from [character].

options.text: If only all my subjects were as effective!

events.text: [character] has surpassed himself, hunting down a cabal of agents in [city] with ruthless efficiency. Leading the guards in storming a grain merchant’s shop that was being used as a front, [character] caught the agents and their possessions before they were destroyed. The seized messages prove that there is also an agent network in [city]. The spies are quickly hunted down and removed from the city.

options.text: The [family] are known for their pale hair.
I recognize the classic [family] nose.
They can each have half of the child.
The mother is the one who would rather give up the child than see it die.

events.text: Two mothers come to you with a living baby, and a dead baby. They both swear that the living child is theirs and the dead child is the other's. They ask you to settle the dispute. How will you decide who is truthful?

events.name: Under the Table

options.text: If that's not a message from the fates, I don't know what is.

events.text: They are gone. It's impossible, of course. They had only rolled under the table. But after moving every piece of furniture, rearranging every item, checking every pocket, the Bone Dice are nowhere to be found.

options.text: This has gone too far already.
I need to know [character] will not be a threat.

events.text: [character], our Spymaster, anxiously requests a private audience. Agitated, he explains that the agents he sent to endear [character] to you have unearthed unexpected revelations. Based on their findings, the heir is deeply involved in a plot to orchestrate your murder. [character]’s inner circle is so secure that none of our agents can reach him, but perhaps with some additional investigation, we could discover a way in.

events.text: Chancellor [character]'s mission to win the support of the [family] family has ended successfully. However, there has been an unexpected outcome. [character], of house [family], now believes that you have some personal interest in him. He requests that you visit the [family] estates to spend some quality time together.

[character] demands that we release these men along with [character], and allow them to return to [rival]. Of course, showing such amnesty will be interpreted as a sign of weakness.

events.name: Utmost Contempt

options.text: If [rival] wishes our ire, they have it.

events.text: The boasts and insults of [character] grow more brazen by the day. [rival] is called weak, an ugly stain on the land not fit to live even in [rival] shadow.
events.triggerData: They may choose shame or War

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Vassal Tribe

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].

events.text: It is done. The [tribe] have bowed before your might and are willing to follow [rival]. With your dominance of the Tribe shown, it is time to settle their lands.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Vengeance abated

options.text: Revenge against me is a dish best not served at all!

events.text: [character] has long been planning his revenge against you, but your long campaign of him has finally convinced him that it is no longer worth it. You are certainly not friends with [character], but he is no longer pursuing revenge.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Veteran Agent

options.text: You must learn through experience.

events.text: Agents sent to [rival] by [character] have arrived back in the capital. They bear news of great success, along with maps and scrolls detailing the entirety of [rival] land. Without your knowledge, [character] traveled with the seasoned agents, and he picked up several useful skills along the way.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: War Among Friends

options.text: In the name of friendship!

requirements.label: Charming character / High Charisma
tip: The leader must have one of: Charming character (a character trait); High Charisma

options.text: Let’s never fight again.
Actually, I’ve changed my mind.

events.text: As Truce talks with [rival] drag on, news arrives that [character] is making the trip himself to the capital to discuss the matter. Although you’ve made it clear that [rival] is willing to pay tribute in order to end the war, you worry that the [rival] [title]’s arrival is not a good sign. It is with equal parts surprise and relief, then, that you greet a very friendly-seeming [character]. “[character], old friend! Please excuse my unannounced visit, but I've grown tired of the bureaucratic drawl of diplomats and ambassadors. This war among friends was a mistake from the beginning. Please, say nothing of tribute. Let’s put this behind us, shall we?”

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: War Council

options.text: You honor me, [character]! Your bodyguard will fight bravely against the [rival].
That is a noble offer, [character], but we don't require such a sacrifice at this time.

events.text: In times of war like these, the Champions of the [family] Family are eager to show their worth. When summoned with the other Family Heads to Hold Court, [character], Oligarch of the [family], offered to send his personal retinue into the fray. We would simply need to provide some funds for their upkeep. The [family] consider this a great honor, and would feel slighted if denied the opportunity to send [character]'s bodyguard to fight for you against the treacherous [rival].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Watch Your Head

options.text: Let this be a lesson to my enemies.

events.text: While frequenting his favorite brothels, [character] finds himself smitten with a captivating young woman. The two adjourn to a smaller chamber, where they partake of wine and each other's company. Once [character] becomes drunk, his young admirer draws a dagger from her cloak and beheads him. The head is never found.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Well Connected

options.text: Bring him into my confidence.
The court will recognize his achievement.
It is wise to honor the whole family.

events.text: Surprisingly, [character] proves instrumental in helping Chancellor [character] pacify the citizens of [city]. It seems he possessed powerful connections among the city's elite. How shall we reward your subject for his assistance?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: What Have We Learned

options.text: Rebuke [character] disobedience.
Rebuke [character] incompetence.

requirements.label: Slothful / Compassionate character
tip: The leader must have one of: Slothful; Compassionate character

options.text: Shrug.

events.text: They say that failure is the best teacher. [character] has, by this standard, perfected the teaching process. Conflicting accusations render the details unclear, but it is fair to say that all parties regard [character] tutoring sessions as time wildly misspent.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: What is Art?

options.text: Bring it out only when the [family] visit.
Salvage it for needed stone.
This is beyond compare! A Masterpiece!
Display it outside the court as a show of gratitude.

events.text: Pleased with the gifts you sent with Chancellor [character], the [family] family has chosen to reciprocate. [character] returns to the palace with a life-size statue of your likeness. Sadly, it is not very flattering. Or very good. In fact, some consider it a monstrosity. What shall we do with this "gift?"

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: You Owe Me

options.text: You are right, I do owe you.
No. I am the [title]. I owe no one.
Would it help if you found a few bags of money outside your villa?

events.text: [character] stops you outside of your chambers with a frazzled look in his eyes. "You have no idea what I had to do to get [character] to support you. I spent day, after day, after day at his side bringing him around." [character] shoves a finger into your chest. "You owe me for this. You owe me big." How shall you respond?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: You Owe Me

options.text: I have always been in the debt of the servants of god.
No. I am the [title]. I owe no one.
Would it help if you found a few bags of money outside the temple?

events.text: [character] stops you outside of your chambers with a frazzled look in his eyes. "You have no idea what I had to do to get [character] to support you. I spent day, after day, after day at his side bringing him around." [character] shoves a finger into your chest. "You owe me for this. You owe me big." How shall you respond?

events.author: Solver
events.name: [character]

options.text: With royal funding, maybe he can discover that easier road.

events.text: You have extended a personal offer of royal sponsorship to [character], a great mathematician who teaches not far from the royal palace. He has written thirteen books on mathematics and you even found the time to read some of the treatise, which is undoubtedly brilliant although difficult to follow. You got as far as book 4 where [character] constructs regular polygons but you couldn't quite follow the process for the six-sided version. During an audience with [character], you ask whether there is an easier way to learn than reading his works but [character]'s replies that there is no Royal Road to geometry.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] Questions

options.text: How can I trust [character] after this?
There is no shame in seeking to learn.
Actually, this portrayal of me is rather flattering.

events.text: As you have been learning about [religion], [character] has been a faithful guide and teacher, answering all of your questions and engaging in theological debates with patience and dignity. It is to your surprise then when you learn that one of his fellow monks has written up the interactions as a philosophical narrative that is quickly spreading across [rival].

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: [family] needs

options.text: Fine, see to whatever they demand.
I will not be extorted. [character] is not so special.

events.text: The [family] are, of course, thrilled that you want to elevate little [character] to the royal house. But naturally there remain administrative considerations, political realities, so many details that need handling. It should be no problem for the royal house of [rival] to smooth these over, shouldn't it?

events.author: Solver
events.name: [religion] Mercenaries

options.text: We welcome them to fight for [rival], and for [religion].
We will not hire them.

events.text: A group of grizzled soldiers approach one of our outposts, offering their allegiance. They say that they are fighters second, and [religion] first. Out of respect for us as [religion] nation, the soldiers are willing to join us for a smaller payment than most mercenaries would request. Should we accept this offer?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [religion] Zeal

options.text: Through military service.

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: With piety and dedication.
By the rejection of worldly pleasures.

events.text: [character] has taken to [religion] as a duck to water. If anything, his zeal can come across too strongly at times, alienating some of the others in the court. [character] asks for your guidance. What is the best way for him to support.
events.triggerData: Convert Target to State Religion Event

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: [resource] of [rival]

options.text: We don't need this Luxury.

events.text: In a hard-won negotiation, [character] has secured an offer of famed [rival] [resource]. It will not come cheaply, however.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: [rival] Discovery

options.text: We can always use a fresh voice in court.
She must focus on understanding this discovery.

events.text: [character]'s spy has managed to escape from [rival] with an abundance of stolen scientific research. This trove of knowledge includes a groundbreaking discovery on which the [rival] have been working for years. This success has us wondering if this spy has potential beyond espionage.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: [rival] Exiles

options.text: Let them come.

events.text: [character]'s infiltrators return with an abundance of information about the [rival], their encampments, and the strengths and weaknesses of their military. But they are not alone... The agents bring a band of [rival] with them, exiles who wish to leave their homeland behind and settle in [rival].

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: [rival] Interference

options.text: I suppose [character] means to provoke a war. He has.
Not the price I wished to pay, but at least [rival] is at last rid of our dear [character].

events.text: Plans were made. Informants found. Deals crafted. Dates set. And yet, in the end, it was all for naught. [character] rode to [city] just days ago, where he used his popularity and connections to invite [rival] forces inside the city itself. [character] was then most pleased to announce [character], and [city], under the protection of the [rival] crown.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: [rival] Plotters

options.text: Storm the hideout and attempt to slay the plotters.
Befriend them, and lead them into a trap.
Ignore them. We will handle them here in [rival].

events.text: While preparing to launch a campaign of subterfuge against [city], [character] encounters a group of radical [rival] plotting their own attacks against us. They have their gaze firmly locked on [city], where they plan to incite rebellion and weaken military outposts. [character] and his men await your command.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: [rival] Pride

options.text: We will add one of their number to the court.
Form militias of those willing to fight.
Host national celebrations in [city].

events.text: [character]'s efforts to sway public opinion in [city] have proven successful... with some unexpected results. Several young leaders have arisen from the forge of local politics, and we could use their support to shore up loyalty. There are also groups of eager fighters in search of a new cause. We should take advantage of this renewed boon in [rival] pride.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: [rival]'s Best Friend

options.text: Wonderful.
Accept the treaty but politely return the gift.

events.text: Our cordial relations with [rival] have paved the way for swift approval of our peace proposal. [character] sends a prize hound pup from his family's own kennels to commemorate the occasion.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [title] On Trial

options.text: Apologize for any wrong-doings and humbly promise to do better.
Blame any and all mistakes on [character].
Argue that any failure to follow doctrine reflects their own religious guidance.
Leave this charade of a council.

events.text: The [religion] High Synod have asked you to speak at their meeting. However, what at first seemed like a sign of respect turns out to be more like a trial, with the leaders of faith questioning your every action that deviated from religious creed in even the slightest way. After reading out a list of the perceived misdemeanors, there is an awkward pause as they wait for your reply. How will you handle this upstart religious council?
